## History

Gracie is a mother in town who participates in discussions with other local mothers after the school year concludes. During these conversations, she talks about Anne's upcoming departure for college, the town's impending loss of Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and the unique imagination of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P2](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0002), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P4](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0004), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P5](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0005), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P7](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0007), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008), +32 more_
